name: 04_missing_field_vs_stale_hint
description: The PO number is genuinely absent from this document's OCR text (damaged/illegible header), AND the supplier already has a confidently-learned hint (usage_count=5, above the apply threshold) that remembers a DIFFERENT po_number value from a previous document. The correct behaviour is to leave po_number empty/unfound — NOT to backfill it from the cached hint.
represents: The structural root cause of the '763321' cross-contamination bug: a per-document 'variable' field (reference number / date) must never be filled from a remembered supplier hint, no matter how many times that hint has been confirmed. This is the regression guard for engine.py::_apply_hints' field_defs[*].is_variable skip — proving a stale cached value cannot be force-applied to a document where extraction legitimately found nothing.
